answer: By the velvet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts split across independent auditors. Written in a concise reports, one example per claim register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The hollow holds work receipts rather than names, so the marble of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
